title: Census text fetches mark their cuts, keep raw bytes for verification and allow only --grep after the url
goal: fetch.py text marks every cut its caps make with a line holding 'cut at' and exits 2 on a truncated or undecodable body, never 1, which means no line matched; fetch.py text prints a one-line JSON body one value per line; fetch.get and the --verify and --diff paths keep a Content-Encoding gzip body's raw bytes, gzip being decoded only for text; a census session's fetch rule is its exact fetch_argv line plus --grep, so a session cannot add a request header; census.py record keeps a whole outcome note; the Terraform azurerm docs route reads the newest release, not the main branch

run:
import gzip, http.server, io, json, subprocess, sys, threading, zipfile
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import fetch
big = io.BytesIO()
with zipfile.ZipFile(big, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    z.writestr('long.txt', ('planted line 3c4d\n' * 140000))
body = {'/long.zip': (big.getvalue(), 'application/zip', None),
        '/bad': (b'this is not gzip', 'text/plain', 'gzip'),
        '/one.json': (json.dumps({'name': 'planted', 'version': '1.2.3', 'items': [1, 2, 3]}).encode(), 'application/json', None),
        '/short': (b'only ten b', 'text/plain', None),
        '/raw.gz': (gzip.compress(b'planted raw 9d0e'), 'application/gzip', 'gzip')}
class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *a):
        pass
    def do_GET(self):
        b, t, enc = body.get(self.path, (b'', 'text/plain', None))
        self.send_response(200 if b else 404); self.send_header('Content-Type', t)
        if enc:
            self.send_header('Content-Encoding', enc)
        if self.path == '/short':
            self.send_header('Content-Length', '1000')
        self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(b)
srv = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), H)
threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
base, bad = 'http://127.0.0.1:%d' % srv.server_address[1], []
def text(path):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/fetch.py', 'text', base + path], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
p = text('/long.zip')
if 'cut at' not in p.stdout + p.stderr:
    bad.append('a member cut at TEXT_MEMBER_CAP is not marked "cut at"')
p = text('/bad')
if p.returncode != 2:
    bad.append('a body that claims gzip and is not exits %d, not 2' % p.returncode)
p = text('/short')
if p.returncode != 2:
    bad.append('a truncated response (IncompleteRead) exits %d, not 2' % p.returncode)
p = text('/one.json')
if p.returncode or len([l for l in p.stdout.splitlines() if l.strip()]) < 3:
    bad.append('a one-line JSON body is not printed one value per line (exit %d)' % p.returncode)
raw = fetch.get(base + '/raw.gz')
raw = raw[0] if isinstance(raw, tuple) else raw
if not bytes(raw[:2]) == b'\x1f\x8b':
    bad.append('fetch.get decodes a gzip Content-Encoding body; --verify and --diff must see the raw bytes')
srv.shutdown()
print(len(bad), 'fetch.py defects from the SP-rmp5zm5a review:', bad)
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

import http.server, os, subprocess, sys, threading
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import census
bad = []
plan = {'files': [], 'git': [], 'fetch': {'S1': [census.fetch_argv('https://example.org/a.pdf')]}, 'learn': []}
allow, _ = census.dispatch_rules(plan, '/tmp/zz-scratch')
rule = [a for a in allow if 'fetch.py' in a and 'kbid.py' not in a]
if not rule or not all(a.endswith(' --grep *)') for a in rule):
    bad.append(('the fetch rule allows more than --grep after the url', rule))
import csv, shutil, tempfile, provider
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
log = os.path.join(d, '2026-10-21.csv')
shutil.copy('kb/public/_census/2026-10-21.csv', log)
sid = next(csv.DictReader(open(log, encoding='utf-8')))['id']
note = 'planted note 6b7c ' + 'x' * 600 + ' end 8e9f'
subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/census.py', 'record', log, '--id', sid, '--outcome', 'confirmed', '--note', note], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
got = next(r for r in csv.DictReader(open(log, encoding='utf-8')) if r['id'] == sid)['outcome_note']
if not got.endswith('end 8e9f'):
    bad.append(('census.py record cut a long note', got[-30:]))
u = 'https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/azurerm/latest/docs/resources/log_analytics_workspace'
r = provider.raw_url(u, provider.for_url(u, provider.providers(None)))[0]
if '/main/' in r:
    bad.append(('the azurerm latest docs route reads the main branch, not the newest release', r))
print(len(bad), 'census session rule, note and route defects:', bad)
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

notes: Operator 2026-10-22: the census fetch code findings of the SP-rmp5zm5a second-half review go to this sprint. Reviewer findings (S2): _gz_text, _zip_members, _tar_members and _members_text cut at TEXT_MEMBER_CAP or TEXT_TOTAL_CAP with no marker, so a --grep miss in the cut part reads as absence; http.client.HTTPException, zipfile RuntimeError/NotImplementedError and tarfile EOFError escape and exit 1 like 'no line matches'; fetch.fetch decodes gzip for every caller (verify_root hashes get(url): a .gz artifact served with Content-Encoding gzip would mismatch _artifacts.csv; provider.decode_body already decodes safely). (S3): the ' *' rule admits --header, a session-chosen header to the source's host; archive reads lack total bounds (member count, binary strings outside TEXT_TOTAL_CAP, sharedStrings.xml, pdftotext output); one-line JSON makes --grep print the whole document (nuget 1.39 MB); census.py record cuts notes near 300 characters; terraform-docs maps latest to main. Not reproduced here and left out: the query-log spool row fetch.py text would write under dispatch_env (no file under _cache/querylog grew in a planted run on 2026-10-22). The total-bound caps have no check: the worker adds a planted case if cheap. Premise on origin/main of 2026-10-22: check 0 lists 4 defects, check 1 lists 3.
